features.title: Smart, Safe, and Automated Recovery
features.subtitle: Combining geolocation, privacy controls, and automated matching algorithms.
features.step1_desc: List your lost or found item with date, approximate location, and distinguishing attributes. Your personal contact information is never published.
features.step2_desc: Our system cross-references category, location radius, timing, and item attributes to notify owners of high-confidence potential matches.
features.step3_desc: Owners answer private verification questions or use QR tags to confirm ownership before coordinating a safe handover at public partner desks.
